scope: Generic CListBaseDlg/CSan9ListDlg table contract, with the tactic catalog as a closed configuration example

evidence.reuse: CSan9ListDlg_ctor has 17 direct specialized constructor callers with distinct configs, resources, vtables, and declared capacities from 9 through 1100
evidence.class_boundary: Runtime class strings CListBaseDlg and CSan9ListDlg align with 0x571800 and 0x5768C0 constructor vtables
evidence.static_config: 0x5FE090 copies 選擇兵法 and the first page property-key array pointer into 0x66C0F0; 0x66C0D8 contains 特徵/說明 page descriptors
evidence.pages: Feature keys are 4,8,48,49,16 with fixed key 1 prepended; description uses key 46 with fixed key 1
evidence.adapter: The generic catalog calls item vtable +0x28 for descriptors, +0x24 for formatting, +0x18 for values, and +0x2C for sort-key mapping
evidence.capacity: Construction and command IDs independently bound the viewport to 15 rows, headers to 20 columns, and page controls to 18
evidence.page_switch: Commands 7441..7458 store the selected page, install its property-key array/count, and request refresh flags 0x52; Ctrl+Tab cycles the same commands
evidence.sorting: Header clicks map the active property key, toggle a direction bit, choose numeric/text comparison, sort the entry container, and update the indicator
evidence.description_binding: Property key 46 returns runtime +0x1E; hiho loading resolves that cache through message 1221 + 3 * sequential tactic ID, while adjacent bases 1219 and 1220 populate +0x10 and +0x15

function_recovery.note: Recovered the tactic catalog static initializer after read-only byte and data-flow validation

ida_changes.read_back: CSan9ListDlg_ctor calls CListBaseDlg_ctor; recovered initializer, page activation, row formatting, control-ID bounds and evidence comments were visible after save; get_tactic_description_resource_text calls the generic resolver with constants 1221, 10 and 3

conclusion: CListBaseDlg and CSan9ListDlg form a reusable data-driven table system. Specialized dialogs supply configuration and item adapters; the common classes own columns, rows, layout, scrolling, sorting, selection, pages and commands. The tactic catalog is one verified instance.
